name: Initial WorkTime ledger
statements:
CREATE TABLE SessionEvent (
    Id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    OccurredAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    TimezoneId TEXT NOT NULL,
    Kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    Source TEXT NOT NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IX_SessionEvent_OccurredAtUtc
    ON SessionEvent (OccurredAtUtc, Id);

CREATE TABLE ManualAdjustment (
    Id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    StartUtc TEXT NULL,
    EndUtc TEXT NULL,
    DurationMinutes INTEGER NULL,
    FromLabel TEXT NULL,
    ToLabel TEXT NULL,
    Reason TEXT NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    SupersedesId TEXT NULL REFERENCES ManualAdjustment (Id),
    CHECK (
        (StartUtc IS NOT NULL AND EndUtc IS NOT NULL AND DurationMinutes IS NULL)
        OR (StartUtc IS NULL AND EndUtc IS NULL AND DurationMinutes > 0)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IX_ManualAdjustment_WorkdayDate
    ON ManualAdjustment (WorkdayDate, CreatedAtUtc);

CREATE TABLE CreditLedgerEntry (
    Id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    WeekStartDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    Minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (Minutes > 0),
    OriginWorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    OriginRevision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IX_CreditLedgerEntry_Week
    ON CreditLedgerEntry (WeekStartDate, WorkdayDate, CreatedAtUtc);

CREATE TABLE NotificationReceipt (
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Trigger TEXT NOT NULL,
    EligibleAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    DeliveredAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    CombinedDeliveryId TEXT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (WorkdayDate, Trigger)
);

CREATE TABLE DailySummaryRevision (
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ComputedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    TimezoneId TEXT NOT NULL,
    SourceFingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    CreditedMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ExcludedMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UnknownMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    NominalTargetMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    EffectiveTargetMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CarryAvailableMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CarryAppliedMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CarryEarnedMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CarryExpiredMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ProjectedDepartureUtc TEXT NULL,
    IndicatorState TEXT NOT NULL,
    SourceQuality TEXT NOT NULL,
    HasPendingReview INTEGER NOT NULL,
    BreakdownJson TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (WorkdayDate, Revision)
);

name: Retry-safe workday events and adjustments
statements: ALTER TABLE SessionEvent ADD COLUMN OperationKey TEXT NULL;
ALTER TABLE ManualAdjustment ADD COLUMN TimezoneId TEXT NULL;

name: Long-lock review confirmations on manual adjustments
statements: ALTER TABLE ManualAdjustment ADD COLUMN ConfirmsReviewId TEXT NULL;

name: Mutually exclusive long-lock review resolutions
statements:
CREATE TABLE LongLockResolution (
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    TimezoneId TEXT NOT NULL,
    ReviewId TEXT NOT NULL,
    ActionKind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        ActionKind IN ('confirm-work', 'exclude', 'finish-at-lock-start')),
    ActionIdentity TEXT NOT NULL,
    CanonicalCreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (WorkdayDate, TimezoneId, ReviewId)
);

name: Rename notification delivery timestamp to reservation timestamp
statements: ALTER TABLE NotificationReceipt RENAME COLUMN DeliveredAtUtc TO ReservedAtUtc;

name: Store exact credit ledger duration ticks
statements:
CREATE TABLE CreditLedgerEntryV6 (
    Id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    WeekStartDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    DurationTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(DurationTicks) = 'integer' AND DurationTicks > 0),
    OriginWorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    OriginRevision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO CreditLedgerEntryV6 (
    Id,
    WorkdayDate,
    WeekStartDate,
    Kind,
    DurationTicks,
    OriginWorkdayDate,
    OriginRevision,
    CreatedAtUtc)
SELECT
    Id,
    WorkdayDate,
    WeekStartDate,
    Kind,
    CASE
        WHEN typeof(Minutes) = 'integer'
            AND Minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 15372286728
        THEN Minutes * 600000000
        ELSE NULL
    END,
    OriginWorkdayDate,
    OriginRevision,
    CreatedAtUtc
FROM CreditLedgerEntry;
DROP TABLE CreditLedgerEntry;
ALTER TABLE CreditLedgerEntryV6 RENAME TO CreditLedgerEntry;

CREATE INDEX IX_CreditLedgerEntry_Week
    ON CreditLedgerEntry (WeekStartDate, WorkdayDate, CreatedAtUtc);

name: Store exact daily summary duration ticks
statements:
CREATE TABLE DailySummaryRevisionV7 (
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ComputedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    TimezoneId TEXT NOT NULL,
    InputFingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    CreditedTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(CreditedTicks) = 'integer' AND CreditedTicks >= 0),
    ExcludedTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(ExcludedTicks) = 'integer' AND ExcludedTicks >= 0),
    UnknownTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(UnknownTicks) = 'integer' AND UnknownTicks >= 0),
    NominalTargetTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(NominalTargetTicks) = 'integer' AND NominalTargetTicks > 0),
    EffectiveTargetTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(EffectiveTargetTicks) = 'integer' AND EffectiveTargetTicks > 0),
    CarryAvailableTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(CarryAvailableTicks) = 'integer' AND CarryAvailableTicks >= 0),
    CarryAppliedTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(CarryAppliedTicks) = 'integer' AND CarryAppliedTicks >= 0),
    CarryEarnedTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(CarryEarnedTicks) = 'integer' AND CarryEarnedTicks >= 0),
    CarryExpiredTicks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        typeof(CarryExpiredTicks) = 'integer' AND CarryExpiredTicks >= 0),
    ProjectedDepartureUtc TEXT NULL,
    IndicatorState TEXT NOT NULL,
    SourceQuality TEXT NOT NULL,
    HasPendingReview INTEGER NOT NULL,
    BreakdownJson TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (WorkdayDate, Revision)
);

INSERT INTO DailySummaryRevisionV7 (
    WorkdayDate,
    Revision,
    ComputedAtUtc,
    TimezoneId,
    InputFingerprint,
    CreditedTicks,
    ExcludedTicks,
    UnknownTicks,
    NominalTargetTicks,
    EffectiveTargetTicks,
    CarryAvailableTicks,
    CarryAppliedTicks,
    CarryEarnedTicks,
    CarryExpiredTicks,
    ProjectedDepartureUtc,
    IndicatorState,
    SourceQuality,
    HasPendingReview,
    BreakdownJson)
SELECT
    WorkdayDate,
    Revision,
    ComputedAtUtc,
    TimezoneId,
    SourceFingerprint,
    CASE WHEN typeof(CreditedMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND CreditedMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN CreditedMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(ExcludedMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND ExcludedMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN ExcludedMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(UnknownMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND UnknownMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN UnknownMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(NominalTargetMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND NominalTargetMinutes BETWEEN 1 AND 15372286728
        THEN NominalTargetMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(EffectiveTargetMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND EffectiveTargetMinutes BETWEEN 1 AND 15372286728
        THEN EffectiveTargetMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(CarryAvailableMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND CarryAvailableMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN CarryAvailableMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(CarryAppliedMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND CarryAppliedMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN CarryAppliedMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(CarryEarnedMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND CarryEarnedMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN CarryEarnedMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN typeof(CarryExpiredMinutes) = 'integer'
        AND CarryExpiredMinutes BETWEEN 0 AND 15372286728
        THEN CarryExpiredMinutes * 600000000 ELSE NULL END,
    ProjectedDepartureUtc,
    IndicatorState,
    SourceQuality,
    HasPendingReview,
    BreakdownJson
FROM DailySummaryRevision;
DROP TABLE DailySummaryRevision;
ALTER TABLE DailySummaryRevisionV7 RENAME TO DailySummaryRevision;

name: Keep only the latest daily summary revision
statements:
DELETE FROM DailySummaryRevision
WHERE Revision < (
    SELECT MAX(latest.Revision)
    FROM DailySummaryRevision AS latest
    WHERE latest.WorkdayDate = DailySummaryRevision.WorkdayDate);

name: Store the weekly debt left at the end of each daily summary
Allow manual adjustment revocations
statements:
CREATE TABLE ManualAdjustmentV10 (
    Id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    WorkdayDate TEXT NOT NULL,
    Kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    StartUtc TEXT NULL,
    EndUtc TEXT NULL,
    DurationMinutes INTEGER NULL,
    FromLabel TEXT NULL,
    ToLabel TEXT NULL,
    Reason TEXT NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    SupersedesId TEXT NULL REFERENCES ManualAdjustmentV10 (Id),
    TimezoneId TEXT NULL,
    ConfirmsReviewId TEXT NULL,
    -- A comparison with NULL would satisfy the CHECK, so a missing duration is ruled out explicitly.
    CHECK (
        (Kind <> 'revoke' AND StartUtc IS NOT NULL AND EndUtc IS NOT NULL AND DurationMinutes IS NULL)
        OR (Kind <> 'revoke' AND StartUtc IS NULL AND EndUtc IS NULL AND DurationMinutes IS NOT NULL
            AND DurationMinutes > 0)
        OR (Kind = 'revoke' AND StartUtc IS NULL AND EndUtc IS NULL AND DurationMinutes IS NULL
            AND SupersedesId IS NOT NULL)
    )
);

INSERT INTO ManualAdjustmentV10 (
    Id,
    WorkdayDate,
    Kind,
    StartUtc,
    EndUtc,
    DurationMinutes,
    FromLabel,
    ToLabel,
    Reason,
    CreatedAtUtc,
    SupersedesId,
    TimezoneId,
    ConfirmsReviewId)
SELECT
    Id,
    WorkdayDate,
    Kind,
    StartUtc,
    EndUtc,
    DurationMinutes,
    FromLabel,
    ToLabel,
    Reason,
    CreatedAtUtc,
    SupersedesId,
    TimezoneId,
    ConfirmsReviewId
FROM ManualAdjustment;
DROP TABLE ManualAdjustment;
ALTER TABLE ManualAdjustmentV10 RENAME TO ManualAdjustment;

CREATE INDEX IX_ManualAdjustment_WorkdayDate
    ON ManualAdjustment (WorkdayDate, CreatedAtUtc);

name: Add built-in activity spans and the activity source selection history
statements:
CREATE TABLE ActivitySpan (
    Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    State TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (State IN ('active', 'idle')),
    StartUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    SettledThroughUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK (SettledThroughUtc >= StartUtc)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_ActivitySpan_StartUtc_State
    ON ActivitySpan (StartUtc, State);

CREATE INDEX IX_ActivitySourceSelection_EffectiveFromUtc
    ON ActivitySourceSelection (EffectiveFromUtc, Id);
